meta_description: Precision Gardening Bristol provides expert garden maintenance, landscaping, and design across Bristol. Reliable local gardener. Free quotes available.
hero_subhead: Professional garden maintenance and landscaping that turns overgrown spaces into outdoor rooms you'll love.
services_subhead: From routine maintenance to full landscape design, we handle every aspect of garden care with precision and attention to detail.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular hedge trimming, grass cutting, and seasonal care keep your garden healthy and tidy year-round. We work on weekly, fortnightly, or monthly schedules to suit your needs.

services.title: Lawn Care & Restoration
services.desc: Patchy, compacted grass? We overseed, aerate, and feed to bring your lawn back to life. Includes moss control and weed treatment.

services.title: Hedge & Tree Work
services.desc: Safe, professional trimming and shaping of hedges and trees. Fully insured and equipped to handle larger specimens.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: Bespoke garden design from concept to completion. Patios, raised beds, pathways, and planting schemes tailored to your space and budget.

services.title: Clearance & Tidying
services.desc: Overgrown garden? We clear, tidy, and dispose of waste responsibly. Perfect for new homeowners or after months of neglect.

services.title: Seasonal Planting & Mulching
services.desc: Spring bedding, autumn planting, and professional mulching to suppress weeds and improve soil. Colour and structure all year.

about_pullquote: I build gardens that people actually want to spend time in.
about_para_1: Precision Gardening was founded on a simple idea: that a well-maintained garden transforms how you feel about your home. Over 12 years, we've worked across Bristol and the surrounding areas, from small city courtyards to sprawling suburban plots. Every job, big or small, gets the same care and attention to detail.
about_para_2: Our customers trust us because we listen. Whether you want a low-maintenance space or a vibrant garden full of colour, we design and maintain exactly what you need. Many of our clients have worked with us for years — that repeat business is something we're genuinely proud of.

reviews.text: Took over our garden maintenance about three years ago now. The lads are reliable, turn up when they say they will, and the garden always looks immaculate. Fair pricing too. Couldn't ask for better service.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had a complete garden overhaul done. Started as a jungle of weeds and overgrown shrubs. The team drew up a design, got on with it, and now it's our favourite room in the house. Brilliant work and good value.
reviews.author: Claire S.

reviews.text: Emergency tidy before a garden party — gave them a call on Monday and they came out Tuesday afternoon. Sorted everything, cleaned up, and left the garden looking beautiful. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: David P.
